title: user_tokens
description: Single-use email-verification and password-reset tokens (UA-4/UA-21). Only sha256(token) is stored (tokenHash, globally unique); the raw 256-bit value exists once, in the mail or the admin-issued link. A token is bound to (userId, purpose): a reset token cannot verify and vice versa. Valid 24 h (verify) or 1 h (reset) from createdAt; usedAt marks the single use. purgeAt (BSON Date) is expiresAt plus a short grace and drives the TTL index, so spent and expired tokens disappear on their own.

issuedVia.description: 'admin' = one-time link issued from the admin page (no outbound mail in v1).
